metadata.title: Successor in Interest and Tangled Title
metadata.author: National Housing Resource Center
metadata.shortDescription:
For many people, most of their wealth is attributed to their home. However, until a tangled title is resolved, homeowners won’t be able to take full advantage of their home’s value. The process of untangling a tangled title is often a complicated legal process that will require a cost.

In this webinar, you will hear from our panel of experts who will outline how to help your clients address successor in interest and tangled title issues.

Lisa Sitkin,  Supervising Attorney at National Housing Law Project 
Sarah Bolling Mancini, Co-Director of Advocacy at the National Consumer Law Center
Elizabeth Blosser, Vice President of Government Affairs with American Land Title Association
Carrie L. Mann, Esq., Vice President of Pennsylvania Land Title Association
